title: alstonia annamensis
intro: Alstonia annamensis, commonly known as the Anamalai tree, is a species of flowering plant in the Apocynaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, particularly in the treatment of fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Alstonia annamensis include its antimalarial, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and sore throat. The bioactive constituents of this plant include lignans, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which have been found to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiparasitic activities.
